title: No More Tears
lyrics:
[00:52.95]The light in the window is a crack in the sky
[01:02.31]A stairway to darkness in the blink of an eye
[01:11.68]A levee of tears to learn she'll never be coming back
[01:21.07]The man in the dark will bring another attack
[01:31.21]Your momma told you that you're not supposed to talk to strangers
[01:40.73]Look in the mirror, tell me, do you think your life's in danger here?
[01:52.96]No more tears
[01:57.69]No more tears
[02:02.24]No more tears
[02:06.91]No more tears
[02:17.06]Another day passes as the night closes in
[02:26.40]The red light goes on to say it's time to begin
[02:36.44]I see the man around the corner waiting, can he see me?
[02:45.55]I close my eyes and wait to hear the sound of someone screaming here
[02:57.84]No more tears
[03:02.56]No more tears
[03:07.14]No more tears
[03:11.68]No more tears
[05:28.76]So now that it's over, can't we just say goodbye? (Bye, bye, goodbye)
[05:38.02]I'd like to move on and make the most of the night
[05:47.46]Maybe a kiss before I leave you this way
[05:56.48]Your lips are so cold, I don't know what else to say
[06:06.16]I never wanted it to end this way, my love, my darling
[06:15.62]Believe me when I say to you in love I think I'm falling here
[06:27.73]No more tears
[06:32.31]No more tears
[06:36.90]No more tears
[06:41.34]No more tears
